question: Which of the following antifungals acts on the 1,3 Beta-D glucan cell wall of fungi ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Caspofungin -> inhibits 1,3 Beta-D glucan synthesis in fungal cell walls -> disrupts cell wall integrity -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Amphotericin B -> does not act on 1,3 Beta-D glucan cell wall of fungi -> 5% confidence. CHAIN: Voriconazole -> does not act on 1,3 Beta-D glucan cell wall of fungi -> 10% confidence. CHAIN: Nystatin -> does not act on 1,3 Beta-D glucan cell wall of fungi -> 95%
analysis: Caspofungin acts on the 1,3 Beta-D glucan cell wall of fungi, making it an effective antifungal agent.
